The base at rows 41-46 is a lumpy rock/bone heap about 5-6 rows tall, shaded as a front face with no distinct top band. Nothing reads as a top surface, so the image is a front elevation. It is debris and the kind matches, but the drawing is upright rather than lying scattered on the floor.
